page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout; u/v and i/j normalised. "qve" read as que. Apostrophe-like mark before "de" in "l'edition 'de" is doubtful. Signature "O s" is uncertain: it may be a numeral 5 in old form. The catchword "bien" is at the right foot. No marginal notes.
